title: IthaGenes
abstract:
**Comments:** SNP associated with avascular necrosis of the humeral and femoral heads in adult sickle cell anemia patients \[PMID: 11480782]. SNP associated with increased risk of hyperhomocysteinemia in individuals from Egypt with beta-thalassaemia major. Elevated homocysteine has been identified as a risk factor for increased oxidative stress leading to endothelial and vascular dysfunction \[PMID: 27187171]. SNP associated with higher incidence of pain in SCD patients from India \[PMID: 23992124].
